title: Amazing Real Alcazar tour
text: We planned a trip to Seville on short notice and so happy that we were able to visit Real Alcazar. Our guide, Carlos was very knowledgeable, and I think it was a much better experience than if we did it without a guide. The team from Tickets4U were great about communication and helping my daughter and I get in to see this amazing palace.
author: 476triciak

title: Carlos our tour guide
text:
Our guide, Carlos, was very friendly and knowledgeable. He was punctual and navigated the small group well throughout the tour in a relaxed and professional way.
Carlos provided insights that we would missed had we relied on Guide Books and we left feeling this was money and time well spent.
author: markhD7700AN

title: Great tour of must see site in Sevilla
text: Despite the hot August temperature, we had a great tour. Carlos was fantastic and did a great job of engaging storytelling that appealed to teenagers and adults. Real Alcazar is a must see for anyone visiting Sevilla and booking with Carlos is highly recommended.
author: Jennifer_M

title: Brilliant tour! So worth the money!
text: This was an excellent tour by Tickets4U. Great communication from Daniel when organising the tour. Brilliant, energetic and informative guide in Reme!
author: Ashley_1972lou

title: Sold out? Try Daniel
text: Daniel was amazing!!  Royal Alcázar was sold out all week and we had several tour operators cancel on us. Daniel got us in and had a great tour
author: abes1024

title: Sold out? Try Daniel's tour!
text: We planned poorly and could not get regular tickets for our preferred day. Daniel was amazing to work with and not only secured tickets when they were sold out but also arranged a private guide.  Javier led us through the palace and gardens.  Tons of information, very fast, but then we had time after to go back and see highlights at a slower pace.  Certainly pricer than standard unguided admission, but well worth it.  Would definitely recommend.
author: joshuah43

title: Fabulous tour
text: Our tour guide, Melissa, was wonderful. Small group and Melissa had great enthusiasm and knowledge. Don't hesitate to book this one!
author: Janice F

title: Great experience…secured at the very last minute!
text: Great experience! I am amazed that Daniel was able to secure tickets last minute (day before) for the Alcázar when it appeared no tickets were available anywhere…AND provide a charming fun knowledgeable guide (Melissa)…for a group of 7. We also got a wedding proposal in the group which added to the fun. Thank you Daniel for making this possible!
author: kckmax

title: Small group tour of Real Alcázar
text: Amazing tour! The tour guide was so friendly and knowledgeable with perfect English (great since our Spanish is minimal!). The small group size was wonderful - we learned and appreciated so much more than we would have walking through on our own but were not part of a big mob and could hear our guide well. The palace is fascinating and beautiful . The peacocks were a highlight . Daniel and his team did a phenomenal job of getting our tickets organized at the last minute.  Thank you!
author: E5263BYjenniferb

title: Alcázar seen through the eyes of a true Sevillan
text:
Fantastic welcome, this group of young guys work together and are a great team. Jose who accompanied us on this wonderful journey inside the Alcázar is a very knowledgeable guide, but above all he tells you the story so that you can enter inside this journey.
I recommend everyone to do the guided tour in Italian with them.
Thanks guys
author: GallesiM
